lex: The College of William and Mary is the owner of the Alan B. Miller Hall at 101 Ukrop Way, which began construction on the 30th of March, 2007. The building was designed by Robert A M Stern and was completed on the 1st of June 2009. The Mason School of Business are the current tenants.
